methodology.authorship: Independently conceived synthetic prose, FAQs and questions. All entities and local facts were invented. No repository source, tests, implementation rules, development data, historical benchmarks, reports, previous holdouts, private documents, other chats or agent history were inspected.
methodology.protocol: Authored input and sealed labels together, then checked the newly authored data using Python standard library only. Fixed labels and a SHA256 seal before any production run. Did not execute the engine, inspect engine output, score results, browse the web or communicate with other chats. Authorship scratch is confined to the sealed-label directory.
methodology.scope: Local grounded extraction with bounded nearby support. Includes natural prose, native FAQ, paraphrase, negation, cross-sentence support, easy and unresolved references, spelling errors, local comparisons, qualifiers, promotional competitors and related-topic negatives. Unanswerable requests have no positive factual answer anywhere in this synthetic corpus.
methodology.grading: Supported full sentences are legitimate answers; exact bare-value formatting is not required. Each required_facts group accepts any one predeclared case-insensitive substring alternative. Requested values, units, relevant polarity and qualifiers are retained. Evidence is verbatim source content or a native FAQ answer. Unanswerables have empty required_facts and supporting_evidence. Do not revise labels after seeing outputs.
methodology.self_check: Verified unique document and question identifiers, unique slugs and queries, exact question-label agreement, published status, source references, verbatim evidence, nonempty fact alternatives and a verbatim evidence alternative for every required group. Reviewed all unanswerables against the complete newly authored corpus. Counts and canonical arrays are sealed.
